package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type courseAssignmentRepositoryStub struct {
	assignments []domain.StudentCourseAssignment
	request     domain.CourseAssignmentRequest
}

func (stub *courseAssignmentRepositoryStub) Assign(
	_ context.Context,
	assignment domain.StudentCourseAssignment,
	request domain.CourseAssignmentRequest,
) (domain.StudentCourseAssignment, bool, error) {
	stub.assignments = append(stub.assignments, assignment)
	stub.request = request
	return assignment, false, nil
}

func (stub *courseAssignmentRepositoryStub) Get(
	_ context.Context,
	studentID string,
	courseID string,
) (domain.StudentCourseAssignment, error) {
	for _, item := range stub.assignments {
		if item.StudentID == studentID && item.CourseID == courseID {
			return item, nil
		}
	}
	return domain.StudentCourseAssignment{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (stub *courseAssignmentRepositoryStub) List(
	_ context.Context,
	studentID string,
) ([]domain.StudentCourseAssignment, error) {
	result := make([]domain.StudentCourseAssignment, 0)
	for _, item := range stub.assignments {
		if item.StudentID == studentID {
			result = append(result, item)
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func TestAssignCourseUsesPlannerOnlySourceAndStableRequestHash(t *testing.T) {
	repository := &courseAssignmentRepositoryStub{}
	useCase := AssignCourse{
		Assignments: repository, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)},
		IDs: &journeyIDStub{values: []string{"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"}},
	}
	result, reused, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), AssignCourseInput{
		StudentID:         "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		CourseID:          "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		PlanningRequestID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		AssignedBy:        domain.CourseAssignmentSourceLearningPlanner,
		IdempotencyKey:    "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
	})
	if err != nil || reused || result.Status != domain.CourseAssignmentAssigned {
		t.Fatalf("assign Course: result=%#v reused=%v err=%v", result, reused, err)
	}
	if len(repository.request.RequestHash) != 64 ||
		repository.request.PlanningRequestID != "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected durable request: %#v", repository.request)
	}
}

func TestAssignCourseRejectsNonPlannerProducer(t *testing.T) {
	_, _, err := (AssignCourse{
		Assignments: &courseAssignmentRepositoryStub{}, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: time.Now()},
		IDs: &journeyIDStub{values: []string{"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"}},
	}).Handle(context.Background(), AssignCourseInput{
		StudentID:         "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		CourseID:          "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		PlanningRequestID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		AssignedBy:        "teacher", IdempotencyKey: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected planner-only validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestGetStudentCoursesSupportsSeveralCourseIDs(t *testing.T) {
	repository := &courseAssignmentRepositoryStub{assignments: []domain.StudentCourseAssignment{
		{StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"},
		{StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"},
	}}
	items, err := (GetStudentCourses{Assignments: repository}).List(
		context.Background(), "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
	)
	if err != nil || len(items) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("list Courses: items=%#v err=%v", items, err)
	}
}

func TestAssignedCourseAccessAllowsActiveAndRejectsArchivedAssignment(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	activeCourseID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	archivedCourseID := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	access := GetStudentCourses{Assignments: &courseAssignmentRepositoryStub{assignments: []domain.StudentCourseAssignment{
		{StudentID: studentID, CourseID: activeCourseID, Status: domain.CourseAssignmentAssigned},
		{StudentID: studentID, CourseID: archivedCourseID, Status: domain.CourseAssignmentArchived},
	}}}
	allowed, err := access.CanAccessCourse(context.Background(), studentID, activeCourseID)
	if err != nil || !allowed {
		t.Fatalf("active assignment access: allowed=%v err=%v", allowed, err)
	}
	allowed, err = access.CanAccessCourse(context.Background(), studentID, archivedCourseID)
	if err != nil || allowed {
		t.Fatalf("archived assignment access: allowed=%v err=%v", allowed, err)
	}
	allowed, err = access.CanAccessCourse(
		context.Background(), studentID, "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
	)
	if err != nil || allowed {
		t.Fatalf("missing assignment access: allowed=%v err=%v", allowed, err)
	}
}
